title: InfuseLoop: Cross-Trajectory Latent Injection for Scalable Parallel Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.22426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parallel Looped Transformers (PLTs) use otherwise idle decoding compute by overlapping recurrent iterations. However, vanilla PLTs scale poorly with depth: they exhibit training-loss spikes, and their quality gains shrink as more loops are added. The benefit of additional loops depends on the information available to each iteration, so we examine whether the existing computational dependencies limit effective depth scaling. We find that only the preceding in-trajectory state is passed across loop boundaries, even though completed cross-trajectory representations are already available. Based on this finding, we propose InfuseLoop, a cross-trajectory latent injection mechanism. It aggregates causally available hidden states from later prediction trajectories through lightweight attention residuals. This design preserves token-parallel training and concurrent loop execution, and requires only $O(Rd)$ additional hidden-state storage. Experim

translated_title: InfuseLoop：面向可扩展并行循环Transformer的跨轨迹潜在注入机制
translated_abstract: 并行循环Transformer（PLT）通过重叠循环迭代来利用原本闲置的解码计算资源。然而，原始的PLT在深度扩展方面表现不佳：它们会出现训练损失尖峰，且随着循环数量的增加，其质量提升逐渐缩小。额外循环带来的收益取决于每次迭代可获取的信息，因此我们研究了现有的计算依赖关系是否限制了有效的深度扩展。我们发现，目前只有轨迹内的前一个状态会在循环边界之间传递，而实际上已完成的跨轨迹表示早已可用。基于这一发现，我们提出了InfuseLoop——一种跨轨迹潜在注入机制。它通过轻量级的注意力残差，从后续预测轨迹中聚合因果可用的隐藏状态。这一设计保留了token并行训练和并发循环执行，且仅需O(Rd)的额外隐藏状态存储。
tldr: 提出InfuseLoop，一种跨轨迹潜在注入机制，通过轻量级注意力残差将后续预测轨迹中因果可用的隐藏状态注入当前迭代，解决了并行循环Transformer随深度扩展出现的训练损失尖峰和收益递减问题，同时保持token并行训练并仅需O(Rd)的额外存储。
en_tdlr: InfuseLoop introduces a cross-trajectory latent injection mechanism that aggregates causally available hidden states from later prediction trajectories via lightweight attention residuals, enabling Parallel Looped Transformers to scale effectively with depth—avoiding training-loss spikes and diminishing returns—while preserving token-parallel training with only O(Rd) additional storage.
